2608.07340.title: H2AL: Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Aggregative Learning for Registration-based Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation
2608.07340.paper_summary: Registration-based Few-shot medical image segmentation (RFMIS) aims to generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled images by warping a labeled image through registration. However, existing methods primarily perform pixel-level optimization and inference in Euclidean space, treating anatomical structures as flat and disjoint. This neglect of inherent hierarchies degrades pseudo-label quality and weakens the discrimination of ambiguous regions, limiting the segmentation performance. To overcome this challenge, we propose a Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Aggregative Learning framework for RFMIS, termed H2AL, that enhances both deformation plausibility and anatomical discrimination for dual-task learning. Specifically, we introduce a Hyperbolic Hierarchy-aware Infusion (H2I) module, which leverages the hierarchical modeling capability of hyperbolic space to learn precise hierarchy-aware representations via transformation-guided supervised hyperbolic contrastive learning, and injects such hierarchical priors into Euclidean space through a gated infusion block while preserving semantic richness. Furthermore, we propose an end-to-end joint optimization algorithm by gradient aggregation, where the gradients from the registration and segmentation decoders, embedding semantic and hierarchical cues, are aggregated to update the shared encoder to promote collaborative learning across tasks. Extensive experiments on two anatomical regions, with five experimental settings, demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our method in both registration and segmentation. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/JiamingCai469/H2AL.
2608.07340.paper_summary_zh: 註冊基礎的少樣本醫學影像分割（RFMIS）旨在通過註冊將標記影像變形來生成未標記影像的偽標籤。<lb/>然而，現有的方法主要在歐幾里得空間中進行像素級優化和推斷，將解剖結構視為平面且不相交。<lb/>這種對固有層次結構的忽視降低了偽標籤的質量，並削弱了對模糊區域的區分能力，限制了分割性能。<lb/>為了克服這一挑戰，我們提出了一個超曲率層次感知聚合學習框架，用於RFMIS，稱為H2AL，該框架增強了雙任務學習中的變形可信度和解剖區分能力。<lb/>具體而言，我們引入了一個超曲率層次感知注入（H2I）模塊，該模塊利用超曲率空間的層次建模能力，通過變換引導的監督性超曲率對比學習來學習精確的層次感知表示，並通過一個門控注入塊將這些層次先驗注入歐幾里得空間，同時保持語義的豐富性。<lb/>此外，我們提出了一種通過梯度聚合的端到端聯合優化算法，其中來自註冊和分割解碼器的梯度，嵌入了語義和層次提示，被聚合以更新共享編碼器，以促進跨任務的協作學習。<lb/>在兩個解剖區域上進行的廣泛實驗，包含五個實驗設置，證明了我們的方法在註冊和分割中的有效性和效率。<lb/>代碼可在 https://github.com/JiamingCai469/H2AL 上公開獲取。
